Mandatory Multi-Cloud Tagging Standard

Every resource provisioned across AWS, GCP, or Azure must mandatorily include the following 5 metadata keys.

Tag Key Description Allowed Values Example
env Execution environment production | staging | dev | sandbox env:production

service Application service or microservice Alphanumeric string with hyphens service:checkout-gateway
owner Email of designated lead Valid enterprise email (@company.com) owner:simone.borghi@company.com

⚡ Runbook 01: Instance Rightsizing EC2 & Compute Engine

  1. Verify 30-day CPU (idle threshold: average utilization below 15%).
  2. Create a backup snapshot of root volume (EBS on AWS or Persistent Disk on GCP).
  3. Schedule maintenance window if instance is not behind an autoscaling Load Balancer.
  4. Modify instance type (e.g., from m5.2xlarge to m5.xlarge) and reboot.
  5. Monitor memory and application latency metrics for 48 hours.

🪣 Runbook 02: S3 Intelligent-Tiering & GCP Autoclass Configuration

  1. Enable tiering on buckets with objects >128 KB and unpredictable access patterns.
  2. Configure transition to Glacier Instant Retrieval after 30 days for logs and telemetry.
  3. Configure abort rule for incomplete Multipart Uploads after 7 days.
